files.used_for: LankaLaw copy of the 1980 revised edition, volume 5; Sannases and Old Deeds is Cap. 136 at PDF pages 110 to 111 (printed VI/310 to VI/311), chain header 'Ordinances Nos. 6 of 1866, 13 of 1867.', head date '[20th October, 1866.]'. Every section (1 to 10) read word for word against the tree. Settled: the missing word 'with' in s.3; 'sannas' for the HTML's 'saunas' at four places in s.7; the marginal note on the s.2 proviso ('Extension of time for producing deeds, &c.'); the '&c.,' form and punctuation of the notes on ss.2, 4, 6, 7 and 10. Left open: 'alt' in s.4, 'saunas' in the s.7 note and in s.10, which both copies print; the compendium's own 'bylaw' in s.10 is its error

statute_note: Principal source: the LankaLaw consolidated HTML (chain block 'Ordinance Nos, 6 of 1866 13 of 1867'), parsed by build_canonical_statutes.py into a 10-section tree with three provisos (s.2, s.7 twice), no subsections, definitions or schedules, and one editorial footnote. Other sources inspected: the registry's compendium PDF (1980 revised edition volume 5, Cap. 136 at PDF pp. 110 to 111, chain 'Ordinances Nos. 6 of 1866, 13 of 1867.'), used as the verification source. Consolidation cutoff: Ordinance No. 13 of 1867, from both headers. Review performed: every section number, marginal note and the full text of all ten sections and three provisos compared word for word against the compendium text layer and its rendered pages. Corrections made from the compendium, each with the HTML reading kept in raw_text or heading_raw: the dropped word 'with' in s.3; 'sannas' for 'saunas' at four places in s.7; the marginal note on the s.2 proviso; the '&c.,' form and punctuation of the notes on ss.2, 4, 6, 7 and 10; the s.2 footnote moved from text to a footnotes field. validate_finalized_trees.py reports 0 errors and 0 warnings. Amendment coverage: 13 of 1867 known but not held, already incorporated in both copies. OCR or structural weaknesses: both copies print 'alt' (s.4), 'saunas' in the s.7 note and in s.10; the compendium prints 'bylaw' (s.10). Both copies are LankaLaw republications carrying the same OCR-type defects; the compendium is not an independent print. Missing sources: a Government Printer print of Cap. 136 or of Ordinances 6 of 1866 and 13 of 1867. Unresolved questions: the three suspect readings above. Lawyer verification: unverified.
